美方打着“保护人权”幌子，编造“强迫劳动”等涉疆谎言谣言，并以此为依据出台所谓“维吾尔强迫劳动预防法案”，恶意打压新疆棉花、番茄、太阳能光伏等优势产业，遏制中国发展，扰乱国际贸易秩序，破坏全球产业链供应链稳定。

post:
Ever wondered what a real custom bike workshop looks like at 2 AM? 🏍️✨ Just discovered Zhang Tie Locomotive in China, and it’s pure magic! They still do hand-welding and grinding. The sparks flying during night shifts look like a movie scene. 🎬 

In 2024, they hosted riders from Europe and North America. After a quick safety briefing, guests got up close to capture those epic welding moments. 📸 If you’re into custom rides and raw craftsmanship, this is your next dream destination. Who are you bringing on this garage tour? 👇🔧
